# Readback

> Spellcheck that read the thread. Readback underlines near-miss names, numbers and dates in a reply by checking them against the message being answered. It runs on the device, makes no network requests and is open source (MIT).

## Pages

- [Landing page](./): what it does, how it works, privacy proof, install steps.
- [Web app](./app/): paste a thread and a reply and watch the guards work in the browser, offline after the first load.
